notes: The page is manuscript p. 65, with a separate pencil 131 at the lower left. It continues a comparison involving Pi_{d,d-prime} and Pi_d (line 1), writes the numbered alpha morphism (215) beside alpha(0)=0 (line 4), then states that the indicated D morphism is finite étale and presents the square (216), marked 2-cart. (lines 5–12). The following sentence describes applications on pi_1 as injective with image of finite index and calls the indicated Pi object a rev. fini (lines 13–17). The oblique note begins Ceci montre que and discusses knowledge of the tilded Pi morphisms from the local ones; its later cancelled passages remain uncertain. The closing paragraph calls the relations essentially formal and trivial, writes marcheraient dans un site quelconque, and continues through le remplacement des at the foot. These are descriptions of the written assertions, not proof checks. The unmatched closing parenthesis after the D-star expression is retained as visible. The raised group above the cancelled verb, marginal arrow orientation, extent of marginal cancellation, final D subscript, and lowest cancelled diagram must remain open for root adjudication. No outside mathematics or expected wording has supplied a reading. For the blind reading, separate target-scoped boxes distinguish the diagonal margin from the crossing upright text, with the source images supplying their spatial relation.
